levels.name: 入门A1
levels.target: 生存英语·最基础日常对话

items.title: 打招呼 Greeting
items.cn: 日常打招呼对话，最基础的问候

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: Hi! How are you?
lines.cn: 嗨！你好吗？

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: I'm fine, thank you. And you?
lines.cn: 我很好，谢谢。你呢？

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: I'm great! Nice to meet you.
lines.cn: 我很好！很高兴认识你。

quiz.q: How is person B?
What does A say at the end?

items.title: 自我介绍 Self-introduction
items.cn: 初次见面介绍自己的名字和国籍

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: Hello, my name is Li Ming.
lines.cn: 你好，我叫李明。

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: Hi, I'm Anna. Where are you from?
lines.cn: 嗨，我是安娜。你来自哪里？

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: I'm from China. And you?
lines.cn: 我来自中国。你呢？

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: I'm from America. Nice to meet you!
lines.cn: 我来自美国。很高兴认识你！

quiz.q: Where is Li Ming from?
Where is Anna from?

items.title: 问时间 Asking the Time
items.cn: 询问和回答当前时间

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: Excuse me, what time is it?
lines.cn: 打扰一下，现在几点了？

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: It's three o'clock.
lines.cn: 三点钟。

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: Thank you very much.
lines.cn: 非常感谢。

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: You're welcome.
lines.cn: 不客气。

quiz.q: What time is it?
What does B say at the end?

items.title: 买东西 Shopping
items.cn: 在小店买水并询问价格

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: Hello, a bottle of water, please.
lines.cn: 你好，请给我一瓶水。

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: Sure. It's two dollars.
lines.cn: 好的。两美元。

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: Here you are. Thank you.
lines.cn: 给你。谢谢。

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: Thank you! Have a nice day.
lines.cn: 谢谢！祝你有美好的一天。

quiz.q: What does A want to buy?
How much is it?

items.title: 问路 Asking the Way
items.cn: 询问洗手间在哪里

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: Excuse me, where is the toilet?
lines.cn: 打扰一下，洗手间在哪里？

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: It's over there, on the left.
lines.cn: 就在那边，左边。

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: Thank you!
lines.cn: 谢谢！

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: No problem.
lines.cn: 没问题。

quiz.q: What is A looking for?
Where is it?

items.title: 谈家庭 Talking about Family
items.cn: 介绍家里有几口人

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: How many people are in your family?
lines.cn: 你家有几口人？

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: There are four people: my parents, my sister and me.
lines.cn: 有四口人：我的父母、我的姐姐和我。

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: Do you have a brother?
lines.cn: 你有兄弟吗？

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: No, I don't. I only have a sister.
lines.cn: 没有。我只有一个姐姐。

quiz.q: How many people are in B's family?
Does B have a brother?

items.title: 点餐 Ordering a Meal
items.cn: 在快餐店点一份套餐

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: Hi, can I have a hamburger, please?
lines.cn: 你好，请给我一个汉堡。

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: Sure. Would you like fries with that?
lines.cn: 好的。要配薯条吗？

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: Yes, a small fries, please.
lines.cn: 要一份小薯条。

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: Anything to drink?
lines.cn: 要喝的吗？

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: A cola, please.
lines.cn: 一杯可乐。

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: That's eight dollars.
lines.cn: 一共八美元。

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: Here you are. Thank you.
lines.cn: 给你。谢谢。

quiz.q: What does A order?
options: A hamburger, fries and a cola

quiz.q: How much is it?
Does A want fries?

items.title: 谈天气 Talking about Weather
items.cn: 早上出门前询问当天天气

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: Good morning. How's the weather today?
lines.cn: 早上好。今天天气怎么样？

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: It's sunny and a little cold.
lines.cn: 晴天，有点冷。

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: Should I wear a jacket?
lines.cn: 我要穿夹克吗？

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: Yes, you'd better. It may be windy later.
lines.cn: 最好穿上。一会儿可能起风。

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: OK. Will it rain today?
lines.cn: 好的。今天会下雨吗？

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: No, the sky is clear.
lines.cn: 不会，天空很晴朗。

quiz.q: How's the weather today?
What does B suggest?
Will it rain today?

items.title: 感谢与道歉 Thanks and Apology
items.cn: 归还借物时表达感谢与歉意

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: Here's your book. Thank you for lending it to me.
lines.cn: 这是你的书。谢谢你借给我。

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: You're welcome. Did you finish it?
lines.cn: 不客气。你看完了吗？

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: Yes, I'm sorry I kept it so long.
lines.cn: 看完了，抱歉借了这么久。

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: That's OK. No problem.
lines.cn: 没关系，没事。

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: I'll buy you a coffee to say thanks.
lines.cn: 我请你喝咖啡表示感谢。

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: That's very kind of you!
lines.cn: 你太客气了！

quiz.q: Why does A thank B?
What does A apologize for?
What does A offer to buy?

items.title: 告别 Saying Goodbye
items.cn: 聚会后与朋友道别

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: It's late. I have to go now.
lines.cn: 很晚了。我得走了。

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: Already? Will you take a taxi?
lines.cn: 这么快？你打车吗？

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: No, I'll take the bus.
lines.cn: 不，我坐公交。

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: OK. Let's meet again next week.
lines.cn: 好。我们下周再见。

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: Sure. Have a good evening!
lines.cn: 好的。祝你度过一个美好的夜晚！

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: Goodbye! Take care.
lines.cn: 再见！保重。

quiz.q: Why does A leave?
How will A go home?
When will they meet again?

levels.name: 初级A2
levels.target: 日常交流·生活场景对话

items.title: 餐厅点餐 Ordering Food
items.cn: 在餐厅点餐和结账

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: Good evening. A table for two, please.
lines.cn: 晚上好。请给我一张两人桌。

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: Sure, this way, please. Here is the menu.
lines.cn: 好的，这边请。这是菜单。

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: I'd like a chicken sandwich and a cup of coffee.
lines.cn: 我想要一个鸡肉三明治和一杯咖啡。

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: Anything else?
lines.cn: 还要别的吗？

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: No, that's all. Thank you.
lines.cn: 不用了，就这些。谢谢。

quiz.q: How many people will eat?
What does A order?
Does A want anything else?

items.title: 预约看病 Booking a Doctor
items.cn: 打电话预约看医生

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: Hello, I'd like to see a doctor, please.
lines.cn: 你好，我想看医生。

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: Sure. What's the problem?
lines.cn: 好的。您哪里不舒服？

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: I have a headache and a fever.
lines.cn: 我头痛，还发烧。

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: Can you come at ten tomorrow morning?
lines.cn: 您明天早上十点能来吗？

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: Yes, ten o'clock is fine. Thank you.
lines.cn: 可以，十点没问题。谢谢。

quiz.q: What's wrong with A?
When will A see the doctor?

items.title: 乘出租车 Taking a Taxi
items.cn: 打车去机场并询问费用

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: Hello, please take me to the airport.
lines.cn: 你好，请送我去机场。

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: OK. Which terminal?
lines.cn: 好的。哪个航站楼？

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: Terminal Two, please. How long does it take?
lines.cn: 请去二号航站楼。要多久？

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: About thirty minutes. The fare is forty yuan.
lines.cn: 大约三十分钟。车费四十元。

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: Here is fifty yuan. Keep the change.
lines.cn: 这是五十元。不用找了。

quiz.q: Where does A want to go?
How long does it take?
How much does A pay?

items.title: 购物退换 Returning Goods
items.cn: 在商店退换有问题的商品

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: Excuse me, I bought this shirt yesterday, but it's too small.
lines.cn: 打扰一下，我昨天买的这件衬衫太小了。

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: Do you have the receipt?
lines.cn: 您有收据吗？

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: Yes, here it is. Can I change it for a bigger one?
lines.cn: 有，在这里。能换件大一号的吗？

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: Of course. Let me find a large size for you.
lines.cn: 当然可以。我给您找件大号的。

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: Thank you very much for your help.
lines.cn: 非常感谢您的帮忙。

quiz.q: What's the problem with the shirt?
What does A want to do?
What does A need to show?

items.title: 借东西 Borrowing Something
items.cn: 向朋友借用雨伞并约好归还时间

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: Hi, could I borrow your umbrella for a while?
lines.cn: 嗨，能借你的伞用一下吗？

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: Sure. When will you return it?
lines.cn: 当然。什么时候还？

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: Tomorrow morning, after the rain stops.
lines.cn: 明天早上，雨停后。

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: No problem. It's the blue one by the door.
lines.cn: 没问题。是门边那把蓝色的。

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: Thank you so much. I'll take good care of it.
lines.cn: 太感谢了。我会好好保管。

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: You're welcome. See you tomorrow.
lines.cn: 不客气。明天见。

quiz.q: What does A want to borrow?
When will A return it?
Which umbrella is it?
options: The blue one by the door

items.title: 邀请朋友 Inviting a Friend
items.cn: 邀请朋友周末一起看电影

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: Hi Tom, are you free this Saturday?
lines.cn: 嗨汤姆，你这周六有空吗？

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: Yes, I am. What's up?
lines.cn: 有空。怎么了？

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: Would you like to see a movie with me?
lines.cn: 你想和我一起看电影吗？

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: Sure! What time does it start?
lines.cn: 当然想！几点开始？

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: At seven in the evening. Let's meet at six thirty.
lines.cn: 晚上七点。我们六点半见。

quiz.q: When is Tom free?
What does A invite Tom to do?
What time does the movie start?

items.title: 问价格 Asking the Price
items.cn: 在市场买T恤并询问折扣

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: Excuse me, how much is this T-shirt?
lines.cn: 打扰一下，这件T恤多少钱？

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: It's fifteen dollars.
lines.cn: 十五美元。

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: That's a bit expensive. Any discount?
lines.cn: 有点贵。有折扣吗？

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: If you buy two, you get ten percent off.
lines.cn: 买两件可以打九折。

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: OK, I'll take two then.
lines.cn: 好，那我要两件。

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: Great. That's twenty-seven dollars in total.
lines.cn: 好的。一共二十七美元。

quiz.q: How much is one T-shirt?
What discount does B offer for two?
How much does A pay in total?

items.title: 做客 Visiting a Friend's Home
items.cn: 去朋友家做客并送礼寒暄

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: Hi, come in! Thanks for coming.
lines.cn: 嗨，请进！谢谢你能来。

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: Thanks for inviting me. Here's some fruit for you.
lines.cn: 谢谢邀请。这是给你带的水果。

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: That's so kind. Please sit down.
lines.cn: 你太客气了。请坐。

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: Your home is lovely. How long have you lived here?
lines.cn: 你家真漂亮。你住这儿多久了？

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: About two years. Would you like some tea or coffee?
lines.cn: 大约两年了。喝茶还是咖啡？

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: Tea, please.
lines.cn: 喝茶，谢谢。

quiz.q: What does B bring?
How long has A lived there?
What does B want to drink?

items.title: 打电话 Making a Phone Call
items.cn: 打电话找人未果并留言

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: Hello, this is Lisa. May I speak to Tom?
lines.cn: 你好，我是丽莎。请找汤姆接电话？

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: Sorry, Tom isn't home right now. Can I take a message?
lines.cn: 抱歉，汤姆现在不在家。要留言吗？

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: Yes, please. Could you ask him to call me back?
lines.cn: 好的。能请他回我电话吗？

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: Sure. What's your number?
lines.cn: 好的。您的号码是多少？

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: It's 555-2310. Thank you.

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: I'll give him the message. Goodbye.
lines.cn: 我会转告他。再见。

quiz.q: Who does Lisa want to speak to?
Why can't Tom come to the phone?
What's Lisa's number?

items.title: 抱怨 Making a Complaint
items.cn: 在餐厅对菜品和服务提出投诉

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: Excuse me, the soup is cold.
lines.cn: 打扰一下，汤是凉的。

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: I'm sorry about that. Let me bring you a new one.
lines.cn: 非常抱歉。我给您换一碗。

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: And we've waited thirty minutes for the main dish.
lines.cn: 而且主菜我们等了三十分钟。

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: I apologize. The kitchen is very busy tonight.
lines.cn: 对不起，今晚厨房太忙了。

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: Could you check on our order, please?
lines.cn: 能帮我们催一下吗？

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: Of course. I'll bring it right away.
lines.cn: 当然，我马上送来。

quiz.q: What's wrong with the soup?
How long have they waited for the main dish?
Why is the kitchen slow?

levels.name: 中级B1
levels.target: 工作学习·较复杂事务对话

items.title: 租房 Renting an Apartment
items.cn: 与中介看房并询问租赁细节

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: Hello, I'm interested in the apartment you advertised.
lines.cn: 你好，我对您广告里的公寓感兴趣。

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: Great. It has two bedrooms, a living room and a kitchen.
lines.cn: 太好了。它有两间卧室、一个客厅和一个厨房。

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: How much is the rent per month?
lines.cn: 每月租金多少？

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: It's 2,000 dollars a month, plus utilities.
lines.cn: 每月2000美元，不含水电费。

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: Is a one-year lease required?
lines.cn: 需要签一年租约吗？

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: Yes, and you need to pay a two-month deposit.
lines.cn: 是的，还需要付两个月押金。

quiz.q: How many bedrooms does the apartment have?
How much is the monthly rent?
What deposit is required?

items.title: 银行开户 Opening a Bank Account
items.cn: 在银行办理开户手续

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: Good morning. I'd like to open a savings account.
lines.cn: 早上好。我想开一个储蓄账户。

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: Certainly. May I see your ID and proof of address?
lines.cn: 好的。请出示您的身份证和地址证明。

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: Here is my passport and a phone bill.
lines.cn: 这是我的护照和一张电话账单。

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: Thanks. Would you like a debit card as well?
lines.cn: 谢谢。您还要一张借记卡吗？

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: Yes, please. Is there a monthly fee?
lines.cn: 要的。有月费吗？

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: No fee if you keep a balance above 500 dollars.
lines.cn: 只要余额保持在500美元以上就免月费。

quiz.q: What kind of account does A want to open?
What documents does A provide?
When is there no monthly fee?

items.title: 工作面试 Job Interview
items.cn: 应聘职位时的面试对话

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: Good morning. Please tell me about your work experience.
lines.cn: 早上好。请介绍一下你的工作经验。

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: I worked as a sales assistant for three years at a retail company.
lines.cn: 我在一家零售公司做了三年销售助理。

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: Why did you leave your last job?
lines.cn: 你为什么离开上一份工作？

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: I wanted to find a job with more challenges and growth.
lines.cn: 我想找一份更有挑战和成长空间的工作。

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: What are your main strengths?
lines.cn: 你的主要优点是什么？

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: I'm hardworking, good at communication and a quick learner.
lines.cn: 我勤奋、善于沟通，学得也快。

quiz.q: How long did B work at the retail company?
Why did B leave the last job?
Which is NOT mentioned as B's strength?

items.title: 机场登机 Airport Check-in
items.cn: 在机场办理登机和托运行李

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: Good evening. Your passport and ticket, please.
lines.cn: 晚上好。请出示护照和机票。

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: Here you are. I'd like a window seat, if possible.
lines.cn: 给您。如果可以，我想要靠窗的座位。

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: Sure. How many bags are you checking in?
lines.cn: 好的。您要托运几件行李？

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: Just one suitcase. It weighs twenty kilos.
lines.cn: 就一个行李箱。重二十公斤。

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: That's within the limit. Boarding starts at gate 12.
lines.cn: 在限额内。登机口是12号。

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: Thank you. When does boarding begin?
lines.cn: 谢谢。几点开始登机？

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: At 9:15. Please be there fifteen minutes early.
lines.cn: 9点15分。请提前十五分钟到达。

quiz.q: What seat does B want?
How much does the suitcase weigh?
When does boarding begin?

items.title: 学校注册 School Enrollment
items.cn: 新生到学校报到注册课程

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: Hello, I'm a new student. I need to register for classes.
lines.cn: 你好，我是新生。我需要注册课程。

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: Welcome. May I have your student ID number?
lines.cn: 欢迎。请告诉我你的学号。

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: It's 20231005. I want to take English and Math.
lines.cn: 是20231005。我想选英语和数学。

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: English is full, but Math has seats on Monday and Wednesday.
lines.cn: 英语已满，但数学周一周三还有名额。

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: Then I'll take Math on Monday and Wednesday.
lines.cn: 那我就选周一周三的数学。

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: Done. Your schedule will be emailed to you tonight.
lines.cn: 好了。你的课表今晚会发到你的邮箱。

quiz.q: What is the student's ID number?
Why can't A take English?
When does A take Math?

items.title: 修电脑 Repairing a Computer
items.cn: 电脑出问题送修与店员沟通

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: Hello, my laptop won't turn on. Can you help?
lines.cn: 你好，我的笔记本开不了机。能帮忙看看吗？

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: Sure. When did the problem start?
lines.cn: 当然。问题什么时候开始的？

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: Yesterday morning. The screen stays black.
lines.cn: 昨天早上。屏幕一直黑着。

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: Let me check. It might be the battery or the screen.
lines.cn: 我检查一下。可能是电池或屏幕的问题。

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: How long will the repair take?
lines.cn: 修理要多久？

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: About two days. I'll call you when it's ready.
lines.cn: 大约两天。好了我打电话给你。

quiz.q: What's wrong with the laptop?
When did the problem start?
How long will the repair take?

items.title: 投诉 Hotel Complaint
items.cn: 在酒店前台投诉房间问题并要求换房

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: Hello, I'd like to complain about my room.
lines.cn: 你好，我想投诉我的房间。

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: I'm sorry to hear that. What's the problem?
lines.cn: 很抱歉。出了什么问题？

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: The air conditioner doesn't work, and the bathroom is not clean.
lines.cn: 空调坏了，浴室也不干净。

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: I apologize. I'll send someone to fix it right away.
lines.cn: 对不起。我马上派人修理。

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: Could you also change my room? I need a quiet one for work.
lines.cn: 能换个房间吗？我工作需要一个安静的。

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: Of course. I'll upgrade you to a quiet room on the fifth floor.
lines.cn: 当然。我给您升级到五楼一间安静的房间。

quiz.q: What's wrong with the air conditioner?
What else is wrong with the room?
Where is the new room?

items.title: 搬家 Moving House
items.cn: 和朋友商量搬家日的安排

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: Are you ready for the move this Saturday?
lines.cn: 这周六搬家准备好了吗？

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: Almost. I've packed most boxes, but the furniture is hard to handle.
lines.cn: 差不多了。大部分箱子打包好了，但家具不好弄。

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: Don't worry. I've rented a van and asked two friends to help.
lines.cn: 别担心。我租了辆面包车，也叫了两个朋友帮忙。

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: That's great. What time will you arrive?
lines.cn: 太好了。你们几点到？

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: Around nine in the morning. The new apartment is only twenty minutes away.
lines.cn: 早上九点左右。新公寓离这儿只有二十分钟。

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: Perfect. I'll have breakfast ready for everyone.
lines.cn: 太好了。我会给大家准备好早餐。

quiz.q: When is the move?
What's hard to handle?
What time will A arrive?

items.title: 聚会聊天 Chatting at a Party
items.cn: 在聚会上与陌生人自我介绍并聊职业

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: Hi, I don't think we've met. I'm Kevin.
lines.cn: 嗨，我们好像没见过。我是凯文。

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: Hello Kevin, I'm Sarah. Are you a friend of the host?
lines.cn: 你好凯文，我是莎拉。你是主人的朋友吗？

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: Yes, we work together. How about you?
lines.cn: 是的，我们是同事。你呢？

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: We were classmates in college. So, what do you do for a living?
lines.cn: 我们大学是同学。你做什么工作？

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: I'm a graphic designer. I mostly work on websites.
lines.cn: 我是平面设计师，主要做网站。

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: That sounds interesting. I work in a hospital as a nurse.
lines.cn: 听起来很有趣。我在医院当护士。

quiz.q: How does Kevin know the host?
What does Kevin do?
What does Sarah do?

items.title: 求职咨询 Career Consulting
items.cn: 向职业顾问咨询转行建议

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: Hello, I'd like some advice on changing careers.
lines.cn: 你好，我想咨询转行的事。

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: Of course. What field are you in now?
lines.cn: 好的。您现在在哪个行业？

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: I've been a teacher for five years, but I want to move into IT.
lines.cn: 我做了五年老师，但想转行做IT。

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: That's a big change. Do you have any technical skills?
lines.cn: 这是很大的转变。您有技术技能吗？

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: I've learned some Python online, and I enjoy solving logical problems.
lines.cn: 我在网上学了些Python，也喜欢解决逻辑问题。

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: Then I'd suggest a six-month coding bootcamp. It's a fast way to build a portfolio.
lines.cn: 那我建议参加六个月的编程训练营，这是快速建立作品集的方式。

quiz.q: What's A's current job?
What field does A want to enter?
What does B suggest?

levels.name: 高级C1
levels.target: 流利表达·商务学术深度对话

items.title: 商务谈判 Business Negotiation
items.cn: 就合同价格与交付条件进行谈判

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: Thank you for the proposal. Frankly, the unit price is higher than we expected.
lines.cn: 感谢您的提案。坦白说，单价高于我们的预期。

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: I understand your concern. However, our quality justifies the premium.
lines.cn: 我理解您的顾虑。但我们的品质足以支撑这个溢价。

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: Could you offer a discount if we commit to a larger volume?
lines.cn: 如果我们承诺更大订单量，能打折吗？

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: If you order above 10,000 units, we can offer a 12% discount.
lines.cn: 如果订量超过一万件，我们可以给12%的折扣。

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: That sounds reasonable. What about the delivery schedule?
lines.cn: 这听起来合理。交付时间表呢？

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: We guarantee shipment within four weeks of the signed contract.
lines.cn: 我们保证签约后四周内发货。

quiz.q: What is A's main concern about the proposal?
options: The unit price is too high

quiz.q: What discount can B offer for over 10,000 units?
What delivery guarantee does B make?

items.title: 会议主持 Chairing a Meeting
items.cn: 主持会议讨论销售进展与对策

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: Good morning, everyone. Let's start with the sales report.
lines.cn: 大家早上好。我们先从销售报告开始。

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: Last quarter we reached 95% of our target, up 8% year on year.
lines.cn: 上季度我们完成了目标的95%，同比增长8%。

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: Solid progress. What's holding back the remaining 5%?
lines.cn: 进展不错。剩下的5%卡在哪里？

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: Mainly supply delays from our Asian factory.
lines.cn: 主要是亚洲工厂的供货延迟。

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: Then let's prioritise an alternative supplier this week.
lines.cn: 那本周我们优先找替代供应商。

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: Agreed. I'll prepare a shortlist by Friday.
lines.cn: 同意。我周五前准备好候选名单。

quiz.q: How much of the target was reached last quarter?
What's holding back the remaining 5%?
When will B prepare a shortlist?

items.title: 新闻采访 News Interview
items.cn: 记者采访一位科学家关于最新发现

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: Doctor, could you explain your team's recent breakthrough in simple terms?
lines.cn: 博士，您能用通俗的话解释一下团队最近的突破吗？

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: Certainly. We found a way to store energy using a new type of battery material.
lines.cn: 当然。我们找到了用一种新型电池材料储能的方法。

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: How significant is this compared to existing technology?
lines.cn: 与现有技术相比，这有多重要？

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: It could double the storage capacity while cutting the cost by roughly thirty percent.
lines.cn: 它能让储能容量翻倍，同时把成本降低约百分之三十。

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: When might ordinary consumers see this in products?
lines.cn: 普通消费者什么时候能在产品中看到它？

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: If trials succeed, commercial versions could appear within three years.
lines.cn: 如果试验成功，商用版本可能在三年内出现。

quiz.q: What did the team discover?
options: A new battery material for energy storage

quiz.q: What improvement does the new material offer?
When might consumers get the product?

items.title: 项目汇报 Project Presentation
items.cn: 向管理层汇报项目进展并回答问题

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: Good afternoon. Today I'll walk you through our Q3 project results.
lines.cn: 下午好。今天我将向大家介绍第三季度项目的成果。

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: Before you continue, what were the total costs versus the budget?
lines.cn: 在你继续之前，总成本与预算相比如何？

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: We spent 92% of the budget, coming in 8% under plan.
lines.cn: 我们花了预算的92%，比计划低8%。

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: Impressive. Did the savings affect quality?
lines.cn: 不错。节省是否影响了质量？

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: Not at all. We optimised suppliers without compromising standards.
lines.cn: 完全没有。我们优化了供应商却没有降低标准。

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: Excellent. What's the biggest risk for next quarter?
lines.cn: 很好。下季度最大的风险是什么？

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: The main risk is a potential shortage of key components.
lines.cn: 主要风险是关键零部件可能短缺。

quiz.q: How much of the budget was spent?
How did they save money?
What's the biggest risk next quarter?

items.title: 客户接待 Receiving a Client
items.cn: 在总部接待来访客户并介绍同事

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: Welcome to our headquarters, Mr. Brown. Did you have a good flight?
lines.cn: 布朗先生，欢迎来到我们总部。航班还好吗？

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: Yes, thank you. I'm looking forward to our factory tour this afternoon.
lines.cn: 是的，谢谢。我期待今天下午参观工厂。

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: Excellent. Before that, let me introduce our production director, Ms. Lee.
lines.cn: 太好了。在那之前，让我介绍我们的生产总监李女士。

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: Pleased to meet you, Ms. Lee. I've heard great things about your team.
lines.cn: 幸会，李女士。久仰你们团队。

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: The feeling is mutual. Shall we move to the conference room for the presentation?
lines.cn: 彼此彼此。我们去会议室开始介绍吧？

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: Lead the way, please.
lines.cn: 请带路。

quiz.q: Who came to visit?
What's planned for the afternoon?
Who does A introduce?

items.title: 团队建设 Team Building
items.cn: 组织团队工作坊并讨论目标与评估

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: Thanks for organising the workshop. What's the goal for today?
lines.cn: 感谢组织这次工作坊。今天的目标是什么？

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: We want to improve cross-team communication and trust.
lines.cn: 我们想提升跨团队沟通与信任。

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: Sounds useful. How will we measure success?
lines.cn: 听起来有用。怎么衡量效果？

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: Through a short survey before and after, plus follow-up in a month.
lines.cn: 通过前后短问卷，加上一个月后回访。

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: Good. What's the first activity?
lines.cn: 好。第一个活动是什么？

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: A problem-solving game where mixed teams race to build a bridge from paper.
lines.cn: 一个解题游戏：混合小组用纸搭桥比赛。

quiz.q: What's the goal of the workshop?
How is success measured?
What's the first activity?

items.title: 技术讨论 Technical Discussion
items.cn: 工程师讨论 API 性能瓶颈与优化方案

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: The new API responds in 800 milliseconds on average. That's too slow for mobile users.
lines.cn: 新API平均响应800毫秒，对移动用户太慢了。

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: Agreed. I suspect the bottleneck is the database query, not the network.
lines.cn: 同意。我怀疑瓶颈在数据库查询，不是网络。

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: How can we confirm that?
lines.cn: 怎么确认？

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: Let's add logging on each query and review the slowest ones this week.
lines.cn: 我们在每个查询加日志，本周检查最慢的。

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: Good plan. If it's the query, should we add an index or cache the results?
lines.cn: 好计划。如果是查询问题，加索引还是缓存结果？

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: Start with caching the most frequent requests. It's lower risk than changing the schema.
lines.cn: 先缓存最频繁的请求，比改表结构风险低。

quiz.q: What's the average response time?
Where does B suspect the bottleneck is?
What does B suggest doing first?

items.title: 培训指导 Training and Coaching
items.cn: 经理指导下属改进客户推介表达

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: I noticed you froze during the client pitch. Let's work on your delivery.
lines.cn: 我注意到你在客户推介时卡壳了。我们来练你的表达。

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: Thanks. I get nervous when senior clients ask unexpected questions.
lines.cn: 谢谢。资深客户问意外问题时我会紧张。

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: That's normal. Let's rehearse three tough questions and your answers.
lines.cn: 这很正常。我们来演练三个刁钻问题及你的回答。

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: OK. What if they ask why our price is higher than competitors?
lines.cn: 好。如果他们问为什么我们价格比竞品高？

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: Reframe it around total cost of ownership, not unit price. Practice that now.
lines.cn: 把它重构到总拥有成本，不是单价。现在练习。

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: Got it. I'll prepare a one-page comparison for next time.
lines.cn: 明白了。我下次准备一页对比。

quiz.q: What problem did A notice?
When does B get nervous?
How does A suggest handling the price question?
options: Reframe around total cost of ownership

items.title: 冲突调解 Conflict Mediation
items.cn: 调解设计与工程团队之间的协作冲突

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: Let's address the tension between design and engineering. What's the core issue?
lines.cn: 我们处理一下设计和工程之间的紧张关系。核心问题是什么？

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: Engineering says design keeps changing specs late in the sprint.
lines.cn: 工程方说设计总在冲刺后期改规格。

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: And design feels engineering ignores their feedback. How can we break this cycle?
lines.cn: 设计方觉得工程忽视反馈。怎么打破这个循环？

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: What if we lock specs every two weeks and route changes through a shared review?
lines.cn: 如果每两周锁定规格，变更走共同评审呢？

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: That adds structure without blocking creativity. Let's trial it next sprint.
lines.cn: 这样既有结构又不阻碍创意。下个冲刺试一下。

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: I'll draft the process and circulate it by end of day.
lines.cn: 我来起草流程，今天结束前发给大家。

quiz.q: What does engineering complain about?
How does design feel?
What solution do they propose?
options: Lock specs every two weeks with shared review

items.title: 跨部门协作 Cross-department Collaboration
items.cn: 市场部与工程部协调产品发布数据

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: Marketing needs product data for the launch campaign. When can we get it?
lines.cn: 市场部需要产品数据做发布活动。什么时候能拿到？

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: We can share the beta test results by next Wednesday. Will that be enough time?
lines.cn: 我们下周三能分享测试结果。时间够吗？

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: Cutting it close, but workable. Can you also include user satisfaction scores?
lines.cn: 有点紧，但可行。能附上用户满意度评分吗？

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: Yes, I'll add a short summary of feedback themes as well.
lines.cn: 可以，我还会附上反馈主题的简短总结。

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: Perfect. I'll loop in the regional teams so they can localise the message.
lines.cn: 太好了。我会通知各地区团队以便本地化。

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: Good idea. Let's hold a thirty-minute sync every Monday until launch.
lines.cn: 好主意。我们每周一开30分钟同步会直到发布。

quiz.q: What does marketing need?
When can engineering share beta results?
What will they do every Monday?

levels.name: 精通C2
levels.target: 母语水平·抽象思辨与专业深度对话

items.title: 哲学辩论 Philosophical Debate
items.cn: 两位学者辩论自由意志与决定论

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: If every action is determined by prior causes, in what sense can we be said to exercise free will?
lines.cn: 如果每个行为都由先前的因决定，我们在何种意义上能说行使了自由意志？

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: That presupposes freedom requires uncaused causes, which itself is metaphysically dubious.
lines.cn: 这预设了自由需要无因之因，而这本身在形而上学上是可疑的。

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: But compatibilism merely redefines freedom as acting on one's desires, which sidesteps the real question.
lines.cn: 但相容论只是把自由重新定义为依欲望行事，回避了真正的问题。

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: I'd argue it clarifies rather than evades: what matters is whether coercion is absent, not whether the universe is deterministic.
lines.cn: 我倒认为这是澄清而非回避：关键在于有无强制，而非宇宙是否决定论。

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: Yet if desires themselves are predetermined, the sense of authorship feels illusory.
lines.cn: 然而若欲望本身也是被决定的，主体的作者感就显得虚幻。

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: Perhaps, but responsibility tracks responsiveness to reasons, not the metaphysical origin of those reasons.
lines.cn: 也许吧，但责任对应的是对理由的回应，而非那些理由的形而上来源。

quiz.q: What does A question at the start?
options: How free will exists if actions are predetermined

quiz.q: What position does B seem to defend?
What does B say responsibility tracks?

items.title: 文学评论 Literary Review
items.cn: 评论家讨论一部小说的叙事技巧

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: The novel's use of an unreliable narrator forces readers to reconstruct truth themselves.
lines.cn: 小说使用不可靠叙述者，迫使读者自行重构真相。

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: Indeed, but the technique risks alienating readers who expect moral clarity from fiction.
lines.cn: 确实，但这技巧可能疏远那些期待小说给予道德明晰的读者。

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: Isn't that ambiguity precisely what elevates it above conventional realism?
lines.cn: 这种含混难道不正是它超越常规现实主义的所在？

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: Up to a point; however, ambiguity can also mask authorial laziness when structure is slack.
lines.cn: 在一定程度上是；然而结构松散时，含混也可能掩饰作者的偷懒。

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: Fair criticism. Yet the final chapter rewards attentive readers with a coherent reinterpretation.
lines.cn: 公允的批评。但末章以连贯的重新解读回报了细心的读者。

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: Agreed. On balance, the ambition outweighs the occasional structural unevenness.
lines.cn: 同意。总体而言，其雄心胜过了偶尔的结构不均。

quiz.q: What narrative technique does the novel use?
What risk does B mention about the technique?
What does the final chapter do for attentive readers?

items.title: 科技前沿 Tech Frontier
items.cn: 专家讨论通用人工智能的影响与风险

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: The trajectory toward artificial general intelligence raises profound governance questions we are ill-equipped to answer.
lines.cn: 通向通用人工智能的轨迹提出了我们难以应对的深刻治理问题。

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: I'm less alarmed. Iterative deployment creates feedback loops that discipline capability growth.
lines.cn: 我不那么忧虑。迭代部署形成反馈回路，约束了能力的增长。

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: That optimism assumes regulators can keep pace with exponentially compounding capability, which historically they cannot.
lines.cn: 这种乐观假设监管者能跟上指数级叠加的能力，而历史表明他们做不到。

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: A fair rejoinder. But international coordination, while slow, is not structurally impossible.
lines.cn: 有力的回应。但国际协调虽慢，并非结构性不可能。

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: Yet coordination requires shared threat models, and the actors disagree on what counts as a risk.
lines.cn: 但协调需要共享的威胁模型，而各方对何为风险意见不一。

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: Then perhaps the priority is epistemic: building common frameworks before we can govern at all.
lines.cn: 那么也许优先的是认识层面：在能治理之前先建立共同框架。

quiz.q: What does A say regulators historically cannot do?
options: Keep pace with exponential capability growth

quiz.q: What does B say is not structurally impossible?
What does B suggest as a priority?

items.title: 外交谈判 Diplomatic Negotiation
items.cn: 两位外交官就一项条约条款激烈交锋

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: Our position is firm: any inspection regime must be mutual and verifiable, or we walk away.
lines.cn: 我方立场坚定：任何核查机制必须是互惠且可验证的，否则我们退出。

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: We appreciate the principle, but mutual inspections raise sovereignty concerns domestically.
lines.cn: 我们理解这一原则，但互惠核查在国内引发主权担忧。

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: Sovereignty cannot be a one-way shield; it must be matched by reciprocal transparency.
lines.cn: 主权不能是单向盾牌；它必须与互惠透明相匹配。

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: Perhaps a phased approach, beginning with confidence-building measures, could bridge the gap.
lines.cn: 或许分阶段推进，从建立信任措施开始，能弥合分歧。

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: We could entertain phased implementation, provided the endpoint is legally binding.
lines.cn: 我们可以考虑分阶段实施，前提是最终目标具有法律约束力。

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: That's a basis for progress. Let us convene technical experts to define the sequencing.
lines.cn: 这是进展的基础。让我们召集技术专家界定排序。

quiz.q: What is A's firm demand?
What concern does B raise about mutual inspections?
What compromise does B propose?

items.title: 艺术批评 Art Criticism
items.cn: 两位评论家对一幅当代作品的评价分歧

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: The piece is intellectually thin; its provocation substitutes for substance.
lines.cn: 这件作品思想单薄；其挑衅替代了实质。

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: I'd counter that provocation itself is the substance when it exposes the viewer's assumptions.
lines.cn: 我反驳：当挑衅揭示观者的预设时，它本身就是实质。

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: But without formal rigor, the gesture collapses into mere spectacle.
lines.cn: 但若缺乏形式严谨，这一姿态便沦为单纯的奇观。

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: Formalism isn't the only criterion; historically aware criticism must weigh context and intent.
lines.cn: 形式主义并非唯一标准；有历史意识的批评必须权衡语境与意图。

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: Intent is unfalsifiable and easily mythologised after the fact.
lines.cn: 意图不可证伪，且极易事后被神话化。

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: True, yet ignoring it altogether flattens interpretation into pure aesthetics, which is its own ideology.
lines.cn: 确实，但完全无视它会把诠释压平为纯粹美学，而那本身也是一种意识形态。

quiz.q: What is A's main criticism of the piece?
What does B argue provocation can do?
What does B warn ignoring intent leads to?
options: Pure aesthetics as its own ideology

items.title: 跨文化比较 Cross-cultural Comparison
items.cn: 两位人类学家讨论礼貌的文化差异

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: Politeness is often framed as universal, yet its rituals vary so widely that the common core seems vanishingly thin.
lines.cn: 礼貌常被说成普世，但其仪式差异之大，使共同核心似乎薄得可怜。

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: The thinness is real at the surface, but the underlying function, face maintenance, recurs cross-culturally.
lines.cn: 表层确很薄，但底层的功能，即面子维护，是跨文化反复出现的。

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: Yet face itself is theorised so differently that the term may be a false friend across traditions.
lines.cn: 然而面子本身被理论化得如此不同，这词跨传统可能是个假朋友。

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: A fair caution. Perhaps we should treat it as a family resemblance concept, not a universal essence.
lines.cn: 公允的提醒。或许我们应把它看作家族相似概念，而非普遍本质。

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: That concession actually strengthens comparative work by preventing conceptual overextension.
lines.cn: 这一让步通过防止概念过度延伸，反而加强了比较研究。

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: Exactly. Precision in framing is what makes difference legible rather than reducible to stereotype.
lines.cn: 正是。表述的精确使差异变得可读，而非简化为刻板印象。

quiz.q: What does A say is vanishingly thin?
What underlying function does B identify?
How does B suggest treating the concept of face?

items.title: 学术答辩 Academic Defense
items.cn: 答辩中回应方法论与泛化能力的质疑

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: Your thesis claims the model outperforms baselines, but your error bars overlap. How do you justify the claim?
lines.cn: 你的论文声称模型优于基线，但误差棒重叠。你如何辩护这个主张？

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: Thank you. The overlap is within one standard deviation, but the paired t-test shows significance at p<0.01.
lines.cn: 谢谢。重叠在一个标准差内，但配对t检验显示p<0.01显著。

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: Even so, your test set is drawn from the same distribution as training. Doesn't that inflate the metric?
lines.cn: 即便如此，你的测试集与训练同分布。这不会虚高指标吗？

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: A fair concern. We've now validated on an out-of-distribution set, and performance degrades gracefully by only 4%.
lines.cn: 公允的担忧。我们已在分布外集合验证，性能仅下降4%，衰减平缓。

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: That's more convincing. How do you handle adversarial inputs not present in your data?
lines.cn: 这更有说服力。你如何处理数据中未出现的对抗输入？

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: We incorporate adversarial training as a regulariser, though I concede robustness under novel attacks remains an open question.
lines.cn: 我们引入对抗训练作为正则项，但我承认在新攻击下的鲁棒性仍是开放问题。

quiz.q: What's A's first concern?
What statistic does B cite?
How much does performance degrade on out-of-distribution data?

items.title: 法律辩论 Legal Debate
items.cn: 辩论虚假信息言论的法律边界与限制原则

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: The statute protects speech that is merely offensive, yet you'd extend it to deliberate disinformation. Where's the limiting principle?
lines.cn: 法律保护仅具冒犯性的言论，你却要扩展到故意虚假信息。界限原则在哪里？

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: The limit is harm: disinformation that proximately causes measurable injury falls outside protected speech.
lines.cn: 界限是伤害：近似造成可衡量损害的虚假信息不在保护之列。

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: But "measurable injury" is elastic. Who decides, and on what standard of proof?
lines.cn: 但"可衡量损害"有弹性。由谁、依何种证明标准决定？

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: Courts would apply the existing clear-and-present-danger test, with evidence assessed on the preponderance standard.
lines.cn: 法院将适用现存的明显且现实危险测试，依优势证据标准评估。

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: That still chills lawful dissent, since speakers can't predict how their words will be retroactively judged.
lines.cn: 这仍会寒蝉合法异见，因为发言者无法预知其言论将被如何追溯评判。

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: Any standard risks some chill; the question is whether it's proportionate and reviewable, which I argue it is.
lines.cn: 任何标准都有寒蝉风险；问题在于是否相称且可审查，我认为是的。

quiz.q: What does A ask B to identify?
What limit does B propose?
options: Harm that proximately causes measurable injury

quiz.q: What test does B say courts would apply?

items.title: 医学伦理 Medical Ethics
items.cn: 讨论预先指示与代理人决策的权重

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: If a patient lacks capacity but previously expressed a clear wish, how much weight should we give it?
lines.cn: 如果患者丧失能力但先前表达过明确意愿，我们应给予多大权重？

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: Advance directives carry strong moral authority, but they must be weighed against current best interests.
lines.cn: 预先指示具有强道德权威，但必须与当前最佳利益权衡。

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: Yet "best interests" is notoriously subjective. Isn't that a backdoor for paternalism?
lines.cn: 但"最佳利益"出了名地主观。这难道不是家长主义的后门？

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: It can be, which is why decisions should involve surrogates and a second clinical opinion.
lines.cn: 可能是，所以决定应涉及代理人和第二临床意见。

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: What if the surrogate's choice contradicts the directive itself?
lines.cn: 如果代理人的选择与指示本身矛盾呢？

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: Then the directive generally prevails, unless there's credible evidence the patient changed their mind.
lines.cn: 那么指示通常优先，除非有可信证据表明患者改变主意。

quiz.q: What carries strong moral authority for B?
What does A worry "best interests" enables?
What prevails if a surrogate contradicts a directive?

items.title: 公共政策 Public Policy
items.cn: 辩论拥堵费的公平性与实施时序

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: A congestion charge reduces traffic, but it disproportionately burdens low-income drivers. How do you address the equity gap?
lines.cn: 拥堵费减少交通，但对低收入驾驶者负担不成比例。你如何解决公平差距？

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: The revenue is ring-fenced for public transit subsidies, which benefit precisely those lower-income groups.
lines.cn: 收入专款用于公交补贴，恰好惠及那些低收入群体。

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: In theory. In practice, transit improvements lag the charge by years, so the harm precedes the benefit.
lines.cn: 理论上如此。实际上，公交改善滞后收费数年，所以损害先于收益。

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: That's why I'd phase in the charge only after the transit upgrades are operational, not before.
lines.cn: 所以我会在公交升级投运后才分阶段引入收费，而非之前。

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: Sensible sequencing. But won't delayed charging squander the political window for action?
lines.cn: 顺序合理。但延迟收费会不会错失行动的政治窗口？

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: There's tension, yes. But legitimacy built on delivered improvements is more durable than speed that breeds backlash.
lines.cn: 确有张力。但基于已交付改善的合法性，比催生反弹的速度更持久。

quiz.q: What's A's equity concern?
How does B say revenue is used?
Why does B phase in the charge after transit upgrades?
options: To build legitimacy and avoid backlash
